focus: 連結塊石質量、層次幾何、基床與施工量測以理解拋石防波堤~Understand rubble-mound breakwaters through stone mass, layered geometry, foundations and construction measurements

units.anchor: 水下有效重量~Submerged effective weight
units.title: 水下有效重量~Submerged effective weight
units.mechanism: 塊石在水下抵抗移動的重量應扣除浮力，材料密度與海水密度共同決定有效重度。含孔隙岩石的吸水狀態和外包體積定義需一致，乾石秤重不能不經轉換就代表水下作用。 假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。 體積量測應明確說明是否包含可進水開口孔隙，否則排水體積與材料密度不相容。~Stone resistance underwater depends on weight minus buoyancy, with both rock and water density controlling effective unit weight. Absorption state and external volume definition must be consistent; a dry weighing result is not directly the submerged action. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN. Volume measurement must state whether water-accessible pores are included; otherwise displaced volume and the selected material density are inconsistent.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN.
units.verify: 將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。以獨立浮力或密度試驗驗證，並保留個別塊石資料而非只報整批平均。分別核對實體、外包與堆積體積定義。~Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions. Verify through independent buoyancy or density testing and retain individual records instead of only a batch average. Check solid, envelope and stockpile volume definitions separately.
units.failure: 若把鬆方堆積體積當成單塊排水體積，孔隙水會被錯算為石料；平均密度看似合理卻可掩蓋弱石和多孔石，造成水下抗力估計系統性偏高。~Using bulk stockpile volume as individual displaced volume counts void water as stone. A plausible average can conceal weak porous pieces and systematically overestimate underwater resistance throughout the placed layer.
units.misconception: 同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。~Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body.
units.practice: 將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。以獨立浮力或密度試驗驗證，並保留個別塊石資料而非只報整批平均。~Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions. Verify through independent buoyancy or density testing and retain individual records instead of only a batch average.

units.anchor: 無因次穩定指標~Dimensionless stability indicator
units.title: 無因次穩定指標~Dimensionless stability indicator
units.mechanism: 波高與有效密度及標稱石徑的比值可組織不同試驗的量級，但本身不包含坡度、波週期、透水性與容許損傷。穩定指標只能在相應實驗關係的適用範圍內解釋，不能自訂一個數字就決定石料規格。 假設Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854、H=3m、Dn=1m，Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892；此處沒有指定合格門檻。 堤頭的三維流況也不同於直線堤身，不能未經驗證共用同一穩定判據。~Wave height relative to effective density and nominal diameter organizes test scales but omits slope, period, permeability and damage definition. Interpret this indicator within the relevant empirical relation; choosing a convenient number alone cannot establish an armour specification. Assume Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854, H=3m and Dn=1m. Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892; no acceptance threshold is assigned. Three-dimensional flow around a breakwater head differs from a straight trunk, so their stability criteria are not automatically interchangeable.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854、H=3m、Dn=1m，Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892；此處沒有指定合格門檻。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854, H=3m and Dn=1m. Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892; no acceptance threshold is assigned.
units.verify: 把波高定義、週期、坡度、層數與損傷指標列成試驗對照表，查明採用關係的校準範圍。再以現地材料形狀和模型層次檢查哪些條件並不相同。將堤身與堤頭測試資料分開比較。~Tabulate wave-height definition, period, slope, layers and damage metric against the calibration range of the chosen relation. Compare actual rock shapes and model layering to identify conditions that differ. Compare trunk and head test evidence as separate cases.
units.failure: 把不同波高定義或不同損傷標準的資料混用，會讓同一穩定數代表不同風險；外觀相似的石坡仍可能因透水性和波週期差異而有不同移動模式。~Mixing wave-height definitions or damage criteria makes one stability number represent different risks. Similar-looking slopes can still develop different movement patterns because their permeability and wave periods are different.
units.misconception: 相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。~The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period.
units.practice: 把波高定義、週期、坡度、層數與損傷指標列成試驗對照表，查明採用關係的校準範圍。再以現地材料形狀和模型層次檢查哪些條件並不相同。~Tabulate wave-height definition, period, slope, layers and damage metric against the calibration range of the chosen relation. Compare actual rock shapes and model layering to identify conditions that differ.

units.anchor: 堆積孔隙與耗能~Packing porosity and dissipation
units.title: 堆積孔隙與耗能~Packing porosity and dissipation
units.mechanism: 護面與堤心孔隙影響水流穿透、壓力釋放與能量耗散，孔隙率卻不是越大越好。級配、形狀和安放方式決定連通性；相同總孔隙體積可能形成截然不同的通道與局部流速。 假設堆體100m³內石料實體60m³，孔隙率n=(100−60)/100=0.40；孔隙比e=40/60=0.667，兩者不同。 層間細料遷移可改變連通孔隙而不顯著改變總孔隙率，需看內部壓力反應。~Armour and core voids influence penetration, pressure relief and energy loss, but more porosity is not automatically better. Grading, shape and placement govern connectivity; equal total void volume can produce very different flow paths and local velocities. Assume100m³ bulk volume contains60m³ solids. Porosity n=0.40 and void ratio e=40/60=0.667 are different quantities. Migration between layers can change connected voids without much change in total porosity, requiring attention to internal pressure response.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設堆體100m³內石料實體60m³，孔隙率n=(100−60)/100=0.40；孔隙比e=40/60=0.667，兩者不同。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume100m³ bulk volume contains60m³ solids. Porosity n=0.40 and void ratio e=40/60=0.667 are different quantities.
units.verify: 由已知石料密度與質量獨立估算實體體積，對照測量堆體外形所得總體積。記錄級配和施工位置，另以透流試驗檢查孔隙是否連通而非只做體積統計。對照流量與壓差檢查內部通道。~Estimate solid volume independently from mass and density and compare it with surveyed bulk geometry. Record grading and placement location, checking connected flow through testing rather than volume statistics alone. Compare measured flow and pressure difference for internal pathways.
units.failure: 細料塞入孔隙會改變內部壓力而未必明顯改變外觀，隨意壓實又可能破壞設計透水性；若只看堆體高度，便無法判斷內部水力功能是否保留。~Fines clog voids and alter internal pressure without obvious external change. Uncontrolled compaction can remove intended permeability, while crest-level surveys alone cannot establish whether internal hydraulic function has been preserved.
units.misconception: 孔隙率與孔隙比只是同一比例的兩種名稱。~Porosity and void ratio are simply two names for the same fraction.
units.practice: 由已知石料密度與質量獨立估算實體體積，對照測量堆體外形所得總體積。記錄級配和施工位置，另以透流試驗檢查孔隙是否連通而非只做體積統計。~Estimate solid volume independently from mass and density and compare it with surveyed bulk geometry. Record grading and placement location, checking connected flow through testing rather than volume statistics alone.

units.anchor: 坡面幾何放樣~Slope geometry setting-out
units.title: 坡面幾何放樣~Slope geometry setting-out
units.mechanism: 水下坡面放樣要區分垂直高度、水平投影與斜面長度，測深資料還需回到共同高程基準。邊坡外形控制材料量和護面連續性，名義坡比正確不表示坡腳與轉折位置都已符合實際斷面。 假設坡比1垂直比2水平、高10m，水平投影20m、斜面長√(10²+20²)=22.36m；不是20m斜長。 斜面護面面積與水平投影面積不同，材料覆蓋密度的分母需跟著定義。~Underwater setting-out distinguishes vertical height, horizontal run and slope length while referencing soundings to one datum. Profile geometry controls material quantity and armour continuity; the nominal slope ratio alone does not confirm toe or transition locations. Assume a1V:2H slope with10m rise. Horizontal run is20m and slope length√(10²+20²)=22.36m, not20m. Armoured slope area differs from its horizontal projection, and the denominator used for coverage density must follow that definition.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設坡比1垂直比2水平、高10m，水平投影20m、斜面長√(10²+20²)=22.36m；不是20m斜長。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a1V:2H slope with10m rise. Horizontal run is20m and slope length√(10²+20²)=22.36m, not20m.
units.verify: 用剖面點重建垂直與水平坐標，檢查潮位、船體姿態和探頭偏置的修正。另在坡腳與堤頂增加測線，避免只用中間一條斜線判定整段層厚。獨立計算水平投影與實際坡面面積。~Reconstruct profile coordinates and check tide, vessel attitude and transducer-offset corrections. Add survey lines at toe and crest rather than using one central slope line to infer layer thickness everywhere. Compute projected and actual slope areas independently.
units.failure: 把斜長當水平距離會使石料數量和安放位置同時偏差，坡腳缺料又可能被高處多料掩蓋；平均斷面面積相同仍無法保證局部支承連續。~Confusing slope length with horizontal run shifts both quantities and placement. Excess material higher up can hide a deficient toe, so equal average cross-sectional area does not prove continuous local support.
units.misconception: 只要平均坡比正確就不必另外檢查坡腳位置。~A correct average slope makes separate toe-position checks unnecessary.
units.practice: 用剖面點重建垂直與水平坐標，檢查潮位、船體姿態和探頭偏置的修正。另在坡腳與堤頂增加測線，避免只用中間一條斜線判定整段層厚。~Reconstruct profile coordinates and check tide, vessel attitude and transducer-offset corrections. Add survey lines at toe and crest rather than using one central slope line to infer layer thickness everywhere.

units.anchor: 反濾相容判讀~Filter compatibility interpretation
units.title: 反濾相容判讀~Filter compatibility interpretation
units.mechanism: 反濾層要限制細料流失並允許排水，保土與透水兩個目標必須一起考慮。粒徑比只是選用準則中的一部分，基土是否分散、級配是否間斷以及波浪反向流都會影響可用性。 假設濾料D15=4mm、基料d85=1mm，比值D15/d85=4；只示範粒徑比，不宣稱符合所有反濾準則。 土工織物還涉及接縫與穿刺，不能套用顆粒反濾的尺寸比便宣告等效。~Filters must retain finer material while allowing drainage, so retention and permeability are joint objectives. Grain-size ratios are only part of a selected criterion; dispersive soil, gap grading and reversing wave flow can change applicability substantially. Assume filter D15=4mm and base d85=1mm, giving ratio4. This illustrates the ratio without claiming compliance with every filter criterion. Geotextiles introduce seam and puncture behavior and cannot be declared equivalent merely by applying a granular-filter size ratio.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設濾料D15=4mm、基料d85=1mm，比值D15/d85=4；只示範粒徑比，不宣稱符合所有反濾準則。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume filter D15=4mm and base d85=1mm, giving ratio4. This illustrates the ratio without claiming compliance with every filter criterion.
units.verify: 分別取得基料與濾料完整級配曲線，核對粒徑符號和試驗方法。採用具適用性的保土與透水判據，再以實際流向和材料狀態檢查需要的相容性試驗。分別標示顆粒層與織物介面缺陷。~Obtain complete grading curves for base and filter and verify percentile definitions and test methods. Apply appropriate retention and permeability criteria, then assess compatibility testing against actual flow reversals and material condition. Map granular-layer and geotextile-interface defects separately.
units.failure: 只挑一個粒徑比合格會漏掉基土被沖走或排水受阻的另一端風險；施工分離造成局部級配改變時，料場檢驗合格也不能證明現地整層有效。~Passing one grain-size ratio can miss either base-material loss or blocked drainage. Segregation during placement changes local grading, so quarry compliance does not establish that the full installed filter remains effective.
units.misconception: 任意基土只要粒徑比等於四就必然滿足反濾要求。~A grain-size ratio of four automatically satisfies filter requirements for every base soil.
units.practice: 分別取得基料與濾料完整級配曲線，核對粒徑符號和試驗方法。採用具適用性的保土與透水判據，再以實際流向和材料狀態檢查需要的相容性試驗。~Obtain complete grading curves for base and filter and verify percentile definitions and test methods. Apply appropriate retention and permeability criteria, then assess compatibility testing against actual flow reversals and material condition.

units.anchor: 標稱石徑與形狀~Nominal diameter and shape
units.title: 標稱石徑與形狀~Nominal diameter and shape
units.mechanism: 標稱石徑是由石塊體積換算的立方體尺度，不是最長邊或篩孔尺寸。扁長石可能有相同質量卻較容易受力翻轉，故尺寸換算需和形狀、裂隙及安放接觸一起判讀。 假設石重M=5000kg、密度ρ=2650kg/m³，Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m；不是石塊最大邊長。 以立方體代表尺寸保留體積而不保留所有投影面，受力仍需實際幾何。~Nominal diameter is the cube-root volume scale, not the longest axis or sieve opening. Slender stones of equal mass may rotate differently under loading, so conversion must be interpreted with shape, fractures and contact arrangement rather than as a complete stability description. Assume mass M=5000kg and densityρ=2650kg/m³. Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m is not the stone's maximum dimension. The equivalent cube preserves volume without preserving every projected face, so load assessment still requires the actual exposed geometry.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設石重M=5000kg、密度ρ=2650kg/m³，Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m；不是石塊最大邊長。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass M=5000kg and densityρ=2650kg/m³. Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m is not the stone's maximum dimension.
units.verify: 對代表性石塊同時量質量、三主軸與裂隙，從密度換算標稱徑後保留原始形狀資料。比較合格級配內的扁長比例，並檢查安放後接觸是否符合設計假設。核對最長與最短主軸的比值。~Measure representative mass, three axes and fractures together, retaining shape data after converting nominal diameter. Compare slenderness within the accepted grading and check whether installed contacts match the intended arrangement. Check the ratio of longest to shortest principal dimensions.
units.failure: 只按噸數驗收可能把扁薄裂石當成等效方塊，吊運和波浪作用下的破碎風險因而被忽略；石塊破裂後級配與孔隙也會一併改變而影響內部排水。~Mass-only acceptance can treat thin fractured pieces as equivalent cubes and overlook breakage during lifting or waves. Fragmentation then changes grading and voids as well as the original external armour geometry.
units.misconception: 標稱石徑一樣表示塊石形狀與翻轉阻力也相同。~Equal nominal diameter implies equal shape and resistance to overturning.
units.practice: 對代表性石塊同時量質量、三主軸與裂隙，從密度換算標稱徑後保留原始形狀資料。比較合格級配內的扁長比例，並檢查安放後接觸是否符合設計假設。~Measure representative mass, three axes and fractures together, retaining shape data after converting nominal diameter. Compare slenderness within the accepted grading and check whether installed contacts match the intended arrangement.

units.title: 流速造成阻力~Current-induced drag
units.mechanism: 波浪軌道流與潮流會對外露石塊產生阻力，受力取決於瞬時相對速度及投影面積。簡化定常阻力式不含加速度慣性、遮蔽與紊流尖峰，不能把單一算值直接當作石塊的完整設計荷載。 假設ρ=1025kg/m³、Cd=1、投影A=2m²、定常v=2m/s，F=ρCdAv²/2=4100N=4.1kN。 流向反轉會改變有效投影與接觸受力，波浪往復作用不能等同單向定常流。~Wave orbital motion and currents impose drag according to instantaneous relative velocity and projected area. A steady drag estimate omits acceleration forces, sheltering and turbulent peaks, so one calculated value is not the complete design action on an exposed stone. Assumeρ=1025kg/m³, Cd=1, projected A=2m² and steady v=2m/s. F=ρCdAv²/2=4100N=4.1kN. Flow reversal changes exposed projection and contact loading, so oscillatory waves cannot be represented as one steady unidirectional current.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設ρ=1025kg/m³、Cd=1、投影A=2m²、定常v=2m/s，F=ρCdAv²/2=4100N=4.1kN。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assumeρ=1025kg/m³, Cd=1, projected A=2m² and steady v=2m/s. F=ρCdAv²/2=4100N=4.1kN.
units.verify: 定義相對流速方向與投影面積，說明阻力係數採用條件及未包含的慣性項。用局部速度量測或水工模型檢查遮蔽差異，保留峰值和平均值的分別。對兩個主要流向分別畫投影面。~Define relative-flow direction and projected area, documenting the drag-coefficient conditions and omitted inertia term. Check sheltering through local velocity measurements or hydraulic models and keep peak and mean values distinct. Draw projected areas separately for both principal flow directions.
units.failure: 速度若用平均值代替瞬間峰值，平方關係會放大低估；石塊移動後暴露面積又可能增大。固定幾何的簡式因而無法描述持續移動與鄰石失穩的連鎖反應。~Replacing instantaneous speed with its mean can strongly understate squared-velocity loading. Movement may expose additional area, so a fixed-geometry estimate cannot represent progressive displacement and the resulting loss of neighboring support.
units.misconception: 流速增加百分之十時阻力也只會增加百分之十。~A ten-percent increase in speed produces only ten-percent more drag.
units.practice: 定義相對流速方向與投影面積，說明阻力係數採用條件及未包含的慣性項。用局部速度量測或水工模型檢查遮蔽差異，保留峰值和平均值的分別。~Define relative-flow direction and projected area, documenting the drag-coefficient conditions and omitted inertia term. Check sheltering through local velocity measurements or hydraulic models and keep peak and mean values distinct.

units.anchor: 基床沉陷與層厚~Foundation settlement and thickness
units.title: 基床沉陷與層厚~Foundation settlement and thickness
units.mechanism: 拋石堤的基床變形會改變坡腳與堤頂高程，也會重新分配護面接觸。平均壓縮應變可估量沉陷，但不能代表差異沉陷或循環孔壓引起的軟化，施工分期與海床土性必須一起記錄。 假設厚H=3m的單層均勻垂直應變0.02，s=εH=0.060m；未包含其他土層或差異沉陷。 沉陷還可能改變有效堤頂出水高，進而影響原先估計的越波和堤後排水需求。~Foundation deformation changes toe and crest elevations and redistributes armour contacts. Average compression strain estimates settlement but does not represent differential movement or cyclic pore-pressure softening. Construction stages must therefore be interpreted together with seabed conditions and their evolution. Assume a3m layer with uniform vertical strain0.02. Settlement s=εH=0.060m excludes other layers and differential movement. Settlement can also reduce effective crest freeboard, altering the overtopping and rear-drainage demand originally estimated for the completed structure.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設厚H=3m的單層均勻垂直應變0.02，s=εH=0.060m；未包含其他土層或差異沉陷。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a3m layer with uniform vertical strain0.02. Settlement s=εH=0.060m excludes other layers and differential movement.
units.verify: 在相同基準下追蹤多個剖面的高程與施工荷載，將即時變形和後續變形分開。核對壓縮層厚度及地下水條件，避免把石堆重排和地基壓縮混成同一機制。把沉陷量換算成有效出水高變化。~Track elevations across several profiles against construction loading using one datum, separating immediate and delayed movement. Verify compressible-layer thickness and groundwater conditions, distinguishing stone rearrangement from deformation of the underlying foundation. Translate settlement into the corresponding effective-freeboard change.
units.failure: 基床局部下陷可能先讓濾層拉開而不是整堤明顯下沉，外觀仍完整時內部已可流失細料；只用堤頂平均沉陷容易漏掉最需要維修的區域。~Localized foundation movement can open the filter before large crest settlement becomes visible. Fine material may escape beneath an intact-looking surface, and average crest movement can miss the area most in need of intervention.
units.misconception: 堤頂平均沉陷很小就代表基床與反濾層沒有局部損傷。~Small average crest settlement proves no local foundation or filter damage exists.
units.practice: 在相同基準下追蹤多個剖面的高程與施工荷載，將即時變形和後續變形分開。核對壓縮層厚度及地下水條件，避免把石堆重排和地基壓縮混成同一機制。~Track elevations across several profiles against construction loading using one datum, separating immediate and delayed movement. Verify compressible-layer thickness and groundwater conditions, distinguishing stone rearrangement from deformation of the underlying foundation.

units.anchor: 吊索角度與受力~Sling angle and force
units.title: 吊索角度與受力~Sling angle and force
units.mechanism: 拋石安放常涉及吊具或抓斗，但載重分配不是把總重平均除以吊索數就結束。索向與垂直方向的角度會改變張力，重心偏移、動態加速度及吊點強度仍需由核准吊裝方案處理。 假設靜態重量100kN由兩索對稱承擔，各與垂直夾30°，T=100/(2cos30°)=57.74kN；不含動載。 此處張力是索的軸向力，不能把垂直分量誤當成吊索本身所承受的力。~Stone placement can involve slings or grabs, but force sharing is not simply weight divided by sling count. Angle from the vertical changes tension, while center-of-gravity offset, dynamic acceleration and attachment capacity still require an approved lifting analysis. Assume static100kN shared symmetrically by two slings each30° from vertical. T=100/(2cos30°)=57.74kN, excluding dynamic loading. Sling tension is axial force; its vertical component must not be mistaken for the force carried by the sling itself.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設靜態重量100kN由兩索對稱承擔，各與垂直夾30°，T=100/(2cos30°)=57.74kN；不含動載。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume static100kN shared symmetrically by two slings each30° from vertical. T=100/(2cos30°)=57.74kN, excluding dynamic loading.
units.verify: 在示意圖標明角度相對垂直或水平的定義，驗算垂直分力和水平分力平衡。另列吊具能力、重心與動載條件，讓教學靜力值不被誤用為現場吊裝設定。以兩索分力總和重新核對平衡。~Label whether angles reference vertical or horizontal and verify both force components. Separately document rig capacity, center of gravity and dynamic conditions so the teaching equilibrium result cannot become a field lifting setting. Recheck equilibrium using the sum of both sling components.
units.failure: 角度定義弄反會使張力估算大幅錯誤，海上吊運的加速度又可能超出靜態值；若只查總重量而忽略索力與吊點，系統最弱介面可能先行破壞。~Reversing the angle convention greatly changes predicted tension, while offshore acceleration exceeds static loading. Checking total weight without sling and attachment forces can leave the weakest interface unrecognized until it governs failure.
units.misconception: 兩條索永遠各承受總重量的一半而不受角度影響。~Two slings always carry half the weight regardless of their angle.
units.practice: 在示意圖標明角度相對垂直或水平的定義，驗算垂直分力和水平分力平衡。另列吊具能力、重心與動載條件，讓教學靜力值不被誤用為現場吊裝設定。~Label whether angles reference vertical or horizontal and verify both force components. Separately document rig capacity, center of gravity and dynamic conditions so the teaching equilibrium result cannot become a field lifting setting.

units.anchor: 損傷斷面與追蹤~Damage profiles and tracking
units.title: 損傷斷面與追蹤~Damage profiles and tracking
units.mechanism: 暴風後護面位移要用固定測區和基準比較，表面凹陷、坡腳隆起與真正石料流失不相同。損傷面積可以組織觀測，但需要搭配位置和時序，避免把移位後仍在斷面內的石塊誤算成完全流失。 假設同一斷面受損面積Ae=8m²、Dn=1m，無因次S=Ae/Dn²=8；這不是百分之八損傷。 同一損傷數的風險仍受位置控制，堤頭或過渡區不能以堤身平均表現代替。~Post-storm armour movement needs fixed survey areas and datums. Surface depressions, toe accumulation and actual material loss differ. A damage-area measure organizes observations only when location and chronology remain available, preventing displaced stones still within the section from being counted as entirely lost. Assume damage area Ae=8m² in one section and Dn=1m. Dimensionless S=Ae/Dn²=8 is not eight-percent damage. The significance of a damage number still depends on location; head or transition damage cannot be replaced by average trunk performance.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同一斷面受損面積Ae=8m²、Dn=1m，無因次S=Ae/Dn²=8；這不是百分之八損傷。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume damage area Ae=8m² in one section and Dn=1m. Dimensionless S=Ae/Dn²=8 is not eight-percent damage.
units.verify: 明確定義受損面積的基準線與積分範圍，重測坡腳和堤頂並保留暴風前後影像。將石塊位移、破碎與反濾外露分開記錄，再與設計採用的損傷定義比較。將坡腳及轉折區另列損傷圖層。~Define the baseline and integration limits for damage area, resurvey toe and crest and retain before/after imagery. Record displacement, breakage and exposed filter separately before comparing with the design's chosen damage definition. Map toe and transition damage as separate survey layers.
units.failure: 若每次測量都換基準或範圍，損傷指標可能下降但實際弱點擴大；局部反濾裸露也可能在整段平均面積中被稀釋，延誤辨識進一步流失的起點。~Changing datum or survey extent can make the index decrease while a weak area expands. Local filter exposure may also disappear in section-wide averaging, delaying recognition of the starting point for further material loss.
units.misconception: 無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。~A dimensionless damage number is a percentage that can be multiplied by one hundred.
units.practice: 明確定義受損面積的基準線與積分範圍，重測坡腳和堤頂並保留暴風前後影像。將石塊位移、破碎與反濾外露分開記錄，再與設計採用的損傷定義比較。~Define the baseline and integration limits for damage area, resurvey toe and crest and retain before/after imagery. Record displacement, breakage and exposed filter separately before comparing with the design's chosen damage definition.

title: 拋石防波堤施工~Rubble-mound breakwater construction
summary: 連結塊石質量、層次幾何、基床與施工量測以理解拋石防波堤。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。~Understand rubble-mound breakwaters through stone mass, layered geometry, foundations and construction measurements. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
history: 本課的知識脈絡採用可核對的工程文獻，而不替工法編造單一發明年份。美國工兵團官方目錄列出二〇〇二年海岸工程手冊分冊；越波研究團隊於二〇〇七年發布首版手冊，二〇一八年第二版擴展結構型式、試驗與結果解釋。香港海港手冊持續列出勘誤，提醒設計引用必須指定版本。紐比金灣與博斯是海岸防護和監測的比較案例，不表示兩地採用了本課每項構件或假設尺寸。歷史資料用於理解方法演進，合成數據則另作學徒推理練習。~The knowledge history follows verifiable publications rather than inventing a single date when the technique was created. USACE lists its Coastal Engineering Manual parts in2002. The overtopping authors issued the first manual in2007 and expanded structural types, testing and interpretation in the2018 edition. Hong Kong continues to list corrigenda, demonstrating why an applied design must identify its reference version. Newbiggin Bay and Borth are comparisons of coastal protection and monitoring, not claims that both used every component or assumed dimension in this course. Publication history explains methodological development; synthetic values separately support the apprentice exercises.
example: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。假設排水體積由2增10%至2.2m³、兩種密度固定，水下有效重量由31.8825增至35.07075kN；此線性增加不代表波浪穩定能力必定增加10%，因形狀與接觸可能改變。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。~This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN. Increasing displaced volume from2 to2.2m³ by10% at fixed densities changes effective weight from31.8825 to35.07075kN. Wave stability does not necessarily improve by10%, because shape and contact can change. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854、H=3m、Dn=1m，Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892；此處沒有指定合格門檻。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854, H=3m and Dn=1m. Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892; no acceptance threshold is assigned.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設堆體100m³內石料實體60m³，孔隙率n=(100−60)/100=0.40；孔隙比e=40/60=0.667，兩者不同。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume100m³ bulk volume contains60m³ solids. Porosity n=0.40 and void ratio e=40/60=0.667 are different quantities.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設坡比1垂直比2水平、高10m，水平投影20m、斜面長√(10²+20²)=22.36m；不是20m斜長。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a1V:2H slope with10m rise. Horizontal run is20m and slope length√(10²+20²)=22.36m, not20m.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設濾料D15=4mm、基料d85=1mm，比值D15/d85=4；只示範粒徑比，不宣稱符合所有反濾準則。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume filter D15=4mm and base d85=1mm, giving ratio4. This illustrates the ratio without claiming compliance with every filter criterion.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設石重M=5000kg、密度ρ=2650kg/m³，Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m；不是石塊最大邊長。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass M=5000kg and densityρ=2650kg/m³. Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m is not the stone's maximum dimension.
